name: EPIC 229039352

text.card: A red giant 6,001 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 0.74 solar masses and 13.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,065 K at its surface.
